system.description:
Shield 100. Absorbs Energy and Kinetic damage like a ship's shields (not Explosive, Melee or Fighting), recharging 10 at the start of your turn; once knocked down it charges back up to half strength first. Runs 10 rounds per Alien Power Cell; changing the cell is a combat action. Alien artefact: making it usable by a human takes a Repair check (12, or 8 with 2,000cr and a week).

Exploration Supplement
